title: Rademacher's theorem on an embedded C¹ submanifold: locally Lipschitz functions are differentiable within M at H^m-a.e. point
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M) and f : ℝ^P → ℝ locally Lipschitz on M. Then for μHE[m]⌞M-almost every x, f is differentiable within M at x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → LocallyLipschitzOn M f → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[m].restrict M), DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ f M x
